start.title: [TODO:ru] The Walls of Jericho
start.text:
[TODO:ru] The city stands shut and silent.
Its walls swallow the horizon.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Charge the gates with full force
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] These walls will not yield to swords.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Lay siege and starve them out
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] The Lord has another way.
[TODO:ru] You bow before His silence.

charge_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Not by Might
charge_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] These stones laugh at sword and spear.
Seek His word first.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You lower your blade.

siege_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] His Plan, Not Yours
siege_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Hunger is no weapon of faith.
Kneel and ask Him.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You step away from the war camp.

divine_word.title: [TODO:ru] "I Have Given It Into Your Hand"
divine_word.text:
[TODO:ru] March around the city six days.
On the seventh, march seven times.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] His ways are not your ways.
[TODO:ru] You bow your face to the earth.

argue_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Faith, Not Reason
argue_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] His command may seem strange.
Obedience is your part.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Your heart settles in trust.

instruct_priests.title: [TODO:ru] Take Up the Trumpets
instruct_priests.text:
[TODO:ru] Seven priests, seven horns of ram.
The ark goes before the people.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Hide the ark behind the warriors
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] His presence must lead, not follow.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Send priests in the rear for safety
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Faith walks in front, not behind.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Place the priests at the front
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] The horns rise toward the sky.

hide_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Let Him Lead
hide_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] His presence is your only banner.
Lift it high before all eyes.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Place the priests at the front
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] The procession forms behind the ark.

rear_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Faith Walks First
rear_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] If He goes before, who can stand?
Let the trumpets lead.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Place the priests at the front
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] The horns lift in trembling hands.

first_march.title: [TODO:ru] The First Circle
first_march.text:
[TODO:ru] Only trumpets break the silence.
Jericho mocks from the walls.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Not yet. Hold your voice.
[TODO:ru] Dust rises beneath quiet feet.

shout_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Wait for His Signal
shout_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Your voice must wait six more days.
Let the horns alone speak.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You close your lips and march.

sixth_day.title: [TODO:ru] Six Days Have Passed
sixth_day.text:
[TODO:ru] The people grow weary, doubting.
Tomorrow is the seventh.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] His promise stands. Hold the line.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Encourage them to trust one more day
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You speak peace through the camp.

quit_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] His Word Does Not Fail
quit_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Six days obeyed are not wasted.
Finish what He began.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Encourage them to trust one more day
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Hope returns to weary faces.

seventh_day.title: [TODO:ru] Seven Times Around
seventh_day.text:
[TODO:ru] The horns blow. The dust rises.
The seventh circle is complete.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] The moment He named has come.
[TODO:ru] Your voice splits the silence open.

wait_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Now Is the Hour
wait_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] He has set this very moment.
Lift your voice without fear.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] The cry rises from every throat.

walls_fall.title: [TODO:ru] The Walls Tremble
walls_fall.text:
[TODO:ru] Stones crack. Towers lean.
Jericho falls into its own dust.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Not your hand. His.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Give all glory to the Lord
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You kneel where the walls once stood.

boast_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] His Victory, Not Yours
boast_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] No sword struck these walls.
Lift your eyes, not your name.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Give all glory to the Lord
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You bow your head in the dust.

ending_obedient.title: [TODO:ru] Into the City
ending_obedient.text:
[TODO:ru] The Lord has given Jericho.
Faith walked where strength could not.
